purpose: Test whether traversal direction changes finite certified search outcome under a strict one-profile budget, then compute an ORIGIN_PRIME receipt from replayed directional invariants and deltas.

witnesses.construction: literal copy of the frozen hardish CNF in pinned C025 selftest
two variable-disjoint copies of C025_HARDISH_BASE; second copy offset by +4
canonical pigeonhole CNF: each of 4 pigeons occupies at least one of 3 holes; no pair of pigeons shares a hole
all 2^5 length-5 clauses, one clause excluding each Boolean assignment on variables 1..5
LCG-generated 3-CNF; seed and generator frozen below; clauses canonicalized without solver feedback
witnesses.generator: state=(1664525*state+1013904223) mod 2^32; each clause draws distinct vars by repeated state%12+1 and sign from next state bit0

tie_rule: If two or more modes are equal on all substantive comparator fields, certified_search_champion MUST be NO_UNIQUE_CHAMPION. Mode name is forbidden as a scientific tie-break.

origin_prime.definition: ORIGIN_PRIME = ORIGIN + exact invariants + replayed directional delta + provenance
origin_prime.ascend_condition: At least one directional delta in certified outcome or paid work exists and every compared receipt replays exactly.
origin_prime.no_ascend_condition: If substantive directional delta is empty, ORIGIN_PRIME status is RETURN_NO_NEW_CERTIFIED_INFORMATION.
